title: The Stalker Horror
description: A psychological horror mod where an unpredictable entity stalks you from the shadows.
body:
![The Stalker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0235013033a479514af78612f3ee1e8003d3f771.png)

(REQUIRES GECKOLIB) https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib

The Stalker is not your typical Minecraft monster that blindly rushes toward you. It is a deeply unsettling presence—an aberration of infinite limbs and a frozen, twisted smile that thrives on the player's fear. Designed under the standards of modern psychological horror, this mod introduces an oppressive survival experience where your worst enemy is your own distraction.

💀 Key Features
Strategic Stalking: Forget about cheap, unfair jump-scares right in your face. The Stalker materializes silently in the far distance (12 blocks away), right at the edge of your field of view, patiently waiting in the shadows of caves or the deep dark of the surface night.

Adaptive Chase (Dynamic AI): Through its internal mechanics, the entity can toggle between two distinct hunting states:

Normal Mode: A cautious pursuer that will give up and vanish if you manage to break its line of sight and sprint far enough away.

Aggressive Mode: An implacable beast. It will aggressively and obsessively hunt you down, completely ignoring distance restrictions and refusing to disappear unless you manage to hide from it for a very prolonged period.

Quadrupedal Frenzy: When provoked or deciding to strike, its anatomy changes drastically. It drops down to all fours to initiate a wild, erratic sprint at a terrifying speed—all while keeping its unhinged, smiling face locked directly onto your camera.

Environment & Door Destruction: The walls of your shelter no longer guarantee safety. The entity shatters glass and foliage in its path. If you try to block it with wooden doors, you will hear a violent wood-snapping impact... and exactly 1 second later, the door will burst into splinters!

3D Spatial Audio Sensation: Experience true paranoia with an optimized audio system. The distorted echo of its breathing and footsteps tracks you dynamically, calculating the exact midpoint between you and the creature so you know exactly how close it is without ever having to look back.
